ev_0005.summary: Figure: trapezoid-like quadrilateral with base B-P-C on one horizontal line (y~278), top line A-D-M horizontal (y~66) with M extending beyond D. Edges: AB, AP, AC (diagonal from A to C), PD (from P up to D), DC. Crossing of AC and PD near (305,173) is an unlabelled interior junction (point_06). All strokes measured solid; no dashed segments. No right-angle square marks verified by detect_right_angle_marker (count 0), so no right_angle objects. No feet. Labels A,B,C,D,P verified by OCR and match the measured points; M label sits right of the end of the top line, not at a verified line endpoint.

payload.notes: Used the PROGRAM-OWNED CV coordinate frame and names (A, B, C, D, M, P) without redefining them, since the program inserts them at the start of the tikzpicture; the instruction's pixel-derived coordinates (e.g. P at x=1.42) were not used because they conflict with that frame. Standalone compile therefore requires the program's insertion. Required named edges AB, AC, AD, AP, BC (as B-P-C), BP, CD, CP, DP are all drawn; all solid, round joins, 1.2pt. No right-angle marks (none verified). Labels use the STYLE METRICS font 12/14.4 with the instructed placements. Remeasurement needed: the program-owned M=(3.862,1.500) is about 0.137 units below the top line y=1.637 (A and D), so D--M will slope slightly rather than run horizontal; please remeasure M. The interior crossing of AC and PD is left unlabelled, as in the source.
